messages:
deploy-bot: Release check FAILED for release=canary-2026-03-20 (preflight)

deploy-bot: reason: envshield.pinlist parity mismatch between staging and prod. Missing key in prod: /configs/envshield/pinlist. run_id=rb-2234506 (logs -> https://logs.internal/rb-2234506)

kai.chen: pinging infra/ops — can you paste the deploybot preflight output? I want the exact diff.

deploy-bot: ```json
{
  "staging": {
    "pinlist": ["variant-alpha-1","variant-stable-2"]
  },
  "prod": {
    "pinlist": ["variant-stable-2"]
  }
}
``` 

anne: ah ok, staging got the new alpha pin after last merge but prod backfill didn't run. This is the feature-flag default we added for envshield; we missed backfilling prod.

sara: do we hotpatch prod now or pause the canary? Thumbs on risk.

miguel: options: (1) backfill secret in vault and let deploy continue (low risk), (2) pin this release to the stable variant (hold rollout) (low-medium), (3) do immediate hotpatch to prod (medium). I'd prefer backfill + small maintenance window.

kai.chen: @ops-oncall what's traffic look like? Any change windows today?

ops-oncall: traffic low until 10:30 PDT. Backfill is fine. If you want to do hotpatch we need a 5m announcement.

anne: I'll do the vault backfill and k8s secret update. Command I'll run:

```bash
# write pinlist to Vault
vault kv put secret/envshield/pinlist value='["variant-alpha-1","variant-stable-2"]'

# sync k8s secret from Vault (internal script)
scripts/sync-secret --path secret/envshield/pinlist --k8s-namespace inference --secret-name envshield-pinlist

# restart deployment to pick up secret
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/envshield
```

sara: @anne please add a short release note line and link to this thread. Tag me when done. We'll keep the canary paused until preflight passes.

anne: running now. I'll post back outputs.

anne: vault write OK. sync script returned: updated secret envshield-pinlist -> new checksum 9f2b4c. kubectl rollout restart triggered.

deploy-bot: re-running preflight...

deploy-bot: preflight PASSED for release=canary-2026-03-20. parity_check: envshield.pinlist matched.

sara: great. Unpause canary when your rollout is stable. Please add to release notes: "fixed envshield pinlist parity (staging->prod backfill); prevented potential mismatch that could route traffic to alpha variant in prod".

kai.chen: I'll add a changelog + short postmortem. Action items: (1) add automated backfill step to the feature-flag merge checklist, (2) add a deploybot check to fail if pinlist key absent in prod instead of just mismatch.

miguel: filing followup ticket: INF-4523 (automate envshield backfill + alert). @sara can you assign to infra next sprint?

sara: assigned to infra. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: noted. Closing incident once postmortem is linked.

deploy-bot: thread closed by deploy-bot.
